annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents BitClub Network as a risk-free home business and solicits participation using claims of earning $200 or thousands of dollars daily. The presenter combines those earnings claims with a named successful team, network-marketing leadership and Bitcoin-mining partner payouts, while the frames reinforce a promotional call to join rather than reporting or critically examining the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promotion explicitly uses network-marketing teams and partners as part of the earning opportunity, connecting the business opportunity to a multi-person recruitment structure. S04 is additionally supported because participation in BitClub's mining pool is presented as a route to recurring Bitcoin income and partner payouts.
